description: Defines classes and structures for HPACK header compression tables used in HTTP/2, including static and dynamic tables, header entries, and related operations.

classes.name: HpackStringPair
classes.description: Represents a header name-value pair with size calculation and debug string.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStaticTable
classes.description: Provides access to the static HPACK header table.

classes.name: HpackDecoderDynamicTable
classes.description: Manages the dynamic HPACK header table with insertions and size updates.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTables
classes.description: Encapsulates static and dynamic tables, providing lookup and management functions.

methods.name: HpackStringPair
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for header pair, size calculation, and debug string.

methods.name: HpackDecoderStaticTable
methods.description: Constructors for static table, lookup method.

methods.name: HpackDecoderDynamicTable
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, size update, insert, lookup, and size accessors.

methods.name: HpackDecoderTables
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, size update, insert, lookup, and accessors for header table size and current size.
